query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('source_pages', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 729 AND 733), 'topics', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.topics WHERE slug IN ('united-nations-organs-boundary-729','united-nations-councils-boundary-730','international-courts-boundary-731','united-nations-secretariat-boundary-732','united-nations-leadership-boundary-733')), 'facts', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 729 AND 733), 'notes', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 729 AND 733), 'mcqs', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 729 AND 733), 'verifications', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 729 AND 733), 'flashcards', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0729-0733:%'), 'search_documents', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.search_documents d WHERE (d.entity_type='fact' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 729 AND 733)) OR (d.entity_type='note' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 729 AND 733)) OR (d.entity_type='mcq' AND d.entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 729 AND 733)))) AS batch_integrity LIMIT 1;
